criteria.secondary_comparison: full versus distance, Brier; log loss and calibration diagnostic
criteria.distance: q=clip((position+0.5)/1.5); unresolved rate from training only
criteria.future: events must start at least 6h after freeze; fixed all-history models, no updating
criteria.transfer: different broker, same symbol; annual models trained only before test year; correlated underlying market is not independent future evidence
criteria.stopping: below 200 events or 180 days: descriptive only; no confirmatory intervals
criteria.selection: original complete-M1-window and target-touch filters; retrospective frozen-model replay, not a live timestamped forecast log

limitations: Frozen retrospective replay with original complete-window selection; no timestamped live forecasts, trading costs, or independent-market proof. Repeated interim reads do not justify early confirmatory conclusions.
